name: b3forge
description: Project-local, cross-harness workflow for AI-assisted development with safe installation lifecycle management.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.hooks.json && node dist/tools/stamp-hooks.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.hooks.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && node --test ".test-dist/*.test.js"
